text: Nate and Joanna discuss reading forgotten books, Joanna's new hiking trail in her hometown (found yesterday), and a trail north of Nate's home. Joanna is lactose intolerant; Nate shared his dairy-free ice cream recipe: coconut milk, vanilla, sugar, salt, chilled then machine-frozen. Joanna plans to make it tonight and report back. Nate owns turtles.
